{{Quote|Wan Sandage is the name. Winning races is my game.|translated=1|Wan Sandage|<ref name="Podracing Tales">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref>}}
'''Wan Sandage''', from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]], was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devlikk/Legends|Devlikk]] who was a [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], and the father of [[Wan Sandage Jr.|Wan Sandage Junior]]. Racing with an [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] [[TurboDyne 99-U/Legends|''TurboDyne'' 99-U]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]], Sandage gained popularity on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Ibanna]]. Considered to be something of a playboy on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Sandage had a following of female fans that watched his races with earnest, although due to his biological makeup he had a natural discombobulation that caused him to lose his sense of direction when off of Ord Radama. Sandage also held onto a rather one-sided rivalry with the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] Podracer pilot [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]]. Due to his species' naturally short lifespan, Sandage believed that in order to preserve his name into the record books, he would need to overcome Sebulba in one major racing event. Willing to cheat to gain the upper-hand, Wan Sandage sought out the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], who was a Podracer himself, to eliminate Sebulba during the upcoming [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], in which Sandage would also participate.

After paying two hefty sums of [[Currency/Legends|money]] to Beedo, the pair set out to eliminate the Dug. During the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta race]], Beedo was unable to eliminate Sebulba, falling behind the Dug and finishing in third place. Sandage on the other hand never finished, crashing during the second lap after going off course and slamming into a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]]. Sandage cobbled together what he could from his downed ''TurboDyne'' and rebuilt it for the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] on the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] held planet of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. Beedo also accompanied Sandage again, and came close to shooting Sebulba down during the race with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. The hit failed again, however. Wan Sandage eventually succumbed to senility and [[Death/Legends|died]] during [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], prompting Aldar Beedo to drop his contract on Sebulba, instead opting to work for the Dug. Sandage's [[Youngling/Legends|son]] carried on his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] legacy through [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]]. Wan Sandage Jr. proved his skill on numerous courses, but was commonly mistaken for the elder Wan Sandage.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You race like an old moisture farmer.|Wan Sandage taunts an opponent|translated=1|audio=WanSandage-taunt.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>}}
From [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]], the [[Devlikk/Legends|Devlikk]] Wan Sandage came from a [[Wan Sandage's family|family]] of 128 brothers and sisters. He became the only [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] of his species in more than thirty generations. Sandage [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] since the age of two, using a Podracer fashioned on Ord Radama itself. On other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] his sense of direction was distorted, rendering him constantly discombobulated when racing. Sandage became desperate to defeat [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]],<ref name=":0">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> willing to result to risky tactics to do so.

[[File:WanSandage-SWREP14.png|thumb|left|150px|Wan Sandage on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].]]

Before the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], Sandage enlisted the aid of the hitman [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] to dispatch [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] [[Podracing/Legends|midrace]], leaving the path to victory open for Sandage. Beedo failed to eliminate Sebulba, though he managed to finish the race himself. However, during the third lap of the race, Sandage had lost control of his racer and crashed into a wayward [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] after going off course. Sandage hired Beedo again, though, during the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] race on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], but again Beedo failed to eliminate Sebulba.<ref name="DB" />

Wan Sandage died during [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. His son, [[Wan Sandage Jr.]], continued to fly with Podracers. Ironically, Aldar Beedo ended up hiring himself out to Sebulba to work as an on-track bodyguard while replacing the Dug's former henchman, the [[Vulptereen/Legends|Vulptereen]] Podracer [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]]. This move gained Sebulba the rivalry of both Bolt and Sandage Jr.<ref name="RRSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:WanSandage_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art of Wan Sandage]]
The [[The Star Wars rough draft|rough draft]] and [[The Star Wars first draft|first draft]] of Star Wars contained a character named [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Sandage]], a noble at the court of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Kayos]] on [[Aquilae (The Star Wars)|Aquilae]]. He counsels the king to yield to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and later betrays the royal family to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. He was omitted from later drafts, but the name was later reused by [[George Lucas]] for the Podracer.

Sandage's voice in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' was provided by [[Bob Bergen]]. In pre-production of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], Wan Sandage was originally the name of [[Neva Kee/Legends|Neva Kee]], and vice-versa.
